Sample_growth_protocol_ch1: The acinar clusters were collected from fresh islet-depleted cell fractions containing digested acinar clusters from cadaveric pancreas donors
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from Trizol lysate using Qiagen miRNesay Mini Kit
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1.1: The preparation was performed using the reagents provided in the NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (NEB #E7760S, New England Biolabs,USA), in conjunction with the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB #E7490) and the NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina (96 Unique Dual Index Primer Pairs, NEB #6440s)
Sample_data_processing: Quality control of sequences were performed using Trime Glore 0.5.0
Sample_data_processing.1: low quality and adapter trimmed using Trim Glore 0.5.0
Sample_data_processing.2: Read were aligned using Hisat2 (v 2.2.1) againes indexed human genome (Homo_sapiens.GRCh38)
Sample_data_processing.3: Read were quatified using featureCounts from subread package 2.0.0
Sample_data_processing.5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Transcript read counts, rowes are transcript values, columns are samples
